title: Raid with your figures
lines: At The Little Raid, choose Your figures before you set out. During that raid you are offered every 1-acorn figure to buy with acorns, and other figures only if you have pulled them at the Grove. Nothing new is for sale: figures still come only from pulls.
Each copy of a figure you have pulled after the first is 1 level: 3% more health and attack, up to level 6. These raids pay Coins and are not counted for the board or the almanac.
